implementation_error_scope: Completed checkpoints, data/source fingerprints, replay and retained epoch records; failures, if any, retained verbatim.

old_50k_L8_conflict.source_reason: Both legacy loops instantiate and train a fresh flow; the depth loop does not reuse the data-size-axis L8 flow. Training and fast evaluation consume RNG; no identical per-configuration initialization/shuffling/sampling seed is reset in these loops.
old_50k_L8_conflict.evidence_limitation: Historical aggregates and source identify two separate training calls; their selected model states and exact per-run RNG histories were not retained for independent replay.
old_50k_L8_conflict.current_resolution: Exactly one N50000_L8 checkpoint/result per training seed, referenced unchanged in both axes; neither legacy value is selected to match.

table8_table9_comparison.limits: Three seeds provide descriptive variation, not proof of equivalence or significance. Historical HMC means and one fast evaluation differ from the common present NUTS means/five-fast-seed average. No best configuration or seed ranking is calculated.

limits: Selected checkpoints contain model weights only; no within-run optimizer/RNG checkpoint was added.
Phase B retains all validation epochs; historical Phase A batch/epoch trajectories cannot be reconstructed from weights.
For completed runs, the validation progress hook changes no model output or checkpoint/early-stopping decision; its recording overhead is included in training wall time.
Reference uncertainty is not included in training-seed or fast-seed SD.
Frozen training-noise versus observed-frequency inference-noise mismatch is retained; no data or protocol repair is made.

FULL_ABLATION_INTEGRITY.json.hash_note: Manifest itself; compute its SHA256 externally, no recursive self-hash.
